newsitem.title: CHINA: China '97 steel import seen at 10 mln T - Xinhua.
newsitem.headline: China '97 steel import seen at 10 mln T - Xinhua.

text.p: China is expected to import 10 million tonnes of steel in 1997, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.

China's total steel demand in 1997 was forecast at 102.6 million tonnes, with 88.5 million tonnes to be supplied by domestic steel plants and 10 million tonnes imported, the news agency said. It did not account for the rest.
Xinhua did not give comparative figures, but the Economic Daily said steel imports in the first seven months of 1996 surged a year-on-year 24.2 percent to 9.14 million tonnes.
The newspaper attributed the rise in steel imports to this year's cuts in customs duties.
Xinhua quoted an expert as saying China's steel market would recover from a slump next year and peak in 1998.
